stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 6 of the article “Counting like the Maya.”

"But it's also so simple that it can be practiced on a dirt floor with minimal resources."

Which text evidence from the article “An Ancient Farming Method” contains a SIMILAR idea?

options.label: A
options.text: a closer look reveals that wide steps, or terraces, are carved into the mountainsides (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: retaining walls kept plants from freezing at night (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: they even grew certain plants together to add nitrogen to the soil (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: they built the canals using natural materials like stone and clay, making them easy to fix (paragraph 7)
